2369a9c976d0e6f0.description:
Own a core part of the LAP product end-to-end - from problem, to roadmap, to a shipped and measured outcome. LAP (Loan Against Property) is a secured-lending product - larger loans, longer timelines, and real operational, credit, and regulatory complexity. As PM, you'll own a slice of it - the customer journey from application to disbursal, onboarding and verification, or a brand-new feature - and be accountable for its outcome. You'll set the roadmap, write the specs, drive engineering, manage the partners in the flow, and bring leadership clear recommendations.

Key Responsibilities: 
• The roadmap and outcomes for your area — turning business goals into a prioritized, defensible plan.
• Clear product specs and user stories; breaking ambiguous problems into shippable pieces.
• Your own data. Pull and interrogate it yourself (SQL, product analytics tools) to find where customers drop off, size opportunities, and prove impact — without waiting on an analyst.
• Flows that survive the real world — designed hand-in-hand with Credit, Sales, Operations, and Compliance.
• The external partners and vendors that sit inside the lending flow — evaluating, negotiating, and managing them (e.g. credit bureau, KYC/video-verification, digital signing, auto-debit mandates, banking and valuation partners).
• The voice of the borrower — including the cases where agents or channel partners sit between us and the customer.
• Direct working relationships with senior leadership, bringing them structured, decision-ready thinking.

What we're looking for (must-haves)
• 1.5–2 years in lending product, within a broader product/analytics background. Secured-lending experience is a strong plus.
• Tech-first. You read technical/API documentation on your own, challenge engineering on how things are built, and reason about trade-offs - not just the screens.
• Data-fluent. You can write or read SQL and build a drop-off funnel yourself.
• Regulatory instinct. You understand how lending regulations (KYC norms, video verification, loan-pricing and fee disclosures, fair lending practices) shape what you can ship — and you design with those guardrails in mind.
• Strong written structuring. You turn a messy problem into a clear one-pager.
• High ownership, street-smart, a genuine go-getter. Comfortable in ambiguity, biased to ship, and you close loops without being chased.
• Influence without authority across Sales, Credit, and Operations.

About Kissht:
Kissht is a Great Place to Work® certified consumer-first credit app transforming the landscape of
consumer lending through data and machine-based decisioning. Serving over 15 million customers, including a significant share from Tier-2 cities and beyond, Kissht offers short-term and long-term loans for personal, business, and recurring needs.

Founded by IIT and IIM alumni and backed by leading investors such as Endiya Partners, Brunei Investment Authority, and the Singapore Government, Kissht is among India’s fastest growing fintech companies. Join us to be part of a dynamic and innovative organization shaping the future of financial technology.

Generative AI (GenAI) & LLM Systems : - Design and implement LLM-based applications (chatbots, copilots, automation tools). - Build and optimize RAG pipelines using vector databases (e.g., FAISS, Pinecone, Weaviate). - Develop agentic workflows using frameworks like LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar. - Implement prompt engineering, structured output generation, and tool/function calling. - Fine-tune or optimize LLMs using techniques like LoRA, QLoRA, or instruction tuning. - Work with open-source and proprietary LLMs (e.g., LLaMA, Mistral, GPT, Qwen). 3. Software Design & Architecture : - Design modular, scalable, and maintainable ML and GenAI systems. - Build APIs and microservices for model serving and GenAI applications. - Contribute to architectural decisions for AI platforms and products. 4. Data Engineering for AI : - Build data pipelines for feature engineering, transformation, and dataset versioning. - Manage structured and unstructured data (documents, embeddings, logs). 5. MLOps & LLMOps : - Implement CI/CD pipelines for ML and GenAI systems. - Manage model and prompt versioning, experiment tracking, and reproducibility. - Monitor systems for performance, drift, hallucinations, latency, and cost. - Implement guardrails, evaluation frameworks, and feedback loops for LLMs. 6. Performance & Scalability : - Optimize inference latency and cost for ML and LLM systems. - Ensure scalability under production workloads (batch + real-time). 7. Documentation : - Create clear documentation for ML models, GenAI pipelines, APIs, and workflows. .

Build the future of banking.

About the Role
Owns the employee lifecycle - onboarding, transitions and offboarding - blending empathy with execution so every touchpoint reflects our culture, efficiency and care. You will partner with HR Business Partners, IT, Workplace and Finance to deliver accurate processes and experiences that keep employees confident, connected and supported from Day 1.


Responsibilities
1. Onboarding & Assimilation 

• 

Own the end-to-end onboarding lifecycle, from pre-boarding to post-joining assimilation, with accuracy, compliance and a strong Day 1 experience. 

• 

Run orientation sessions on mission, culture and structure, and coordinate with IT, Workplace and HR on Day 1 readiness. 

• 

Facilitate assimilation programmes - new-joiner connects, check-ins, buddy programmes and milestone feedback. 

• 

Maintain a feedback-driven onboarding framework, using HR automation, AI-assisted drafting and self-service chatbots to cut manual effort and turnaround. 

2. Offboarding & Exit Management 

• 

Manage offboarding end-to-end, from resignation to last working day, tracking timelines and process steps. 

• 

Coordinate clearance across IT, Finance, Workplace, HR Shared Services and reporting managers through to completion. 

• 

Issue exit documentation (resignation acceptance, relieving and experience letters) accurately and on time, and prepare and validate final settlement inputs for payroll within cut-offs. 

• 

Conduct exit interviews where applicable, capturing feedback and attrition trends to inform retention. 

3. HR Operations & Data Governance 

• 

Maintain accuracy and integrity of employee data across HRIS and onboarding platforms. 

• 

Support lifecycle transactions - confirmations, internal transfers and related documentation. 

• 

Ensure compliance and audit readiness through timely updates and report validation. 

• 

Generate MIS and dashboard reports for reviews, using automation to streamline recurring outputs. 

4. Engagement & Partnering 

• 

Drive site-level engagement, culture-building, celebrations and recognition that reinforce belonging.

• 

Track engagement metrics and feedback to spot trends, using analytics tools to speed up sentiment analysis. 

• 

Partner with the HR Business Partner on lifecycle initiatives, pulse surveys and location-level interventions, providing on-ground operational support to employees and managers. 

• 

Work with Talent Acquisition, Finance, IT and Workplace to ensure smooth, accountable process delivery.

Skills
• HR Tools proficiency: Hands-on experience with Darwinbox, Fresh Services and MS Suite.

• Operational excellence: Strong coordination, attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities to deadline.

• Communication: Excellent interpersonal and presentation skills across diverse audiences.

• Data & AI judgement: Comfortable using HRIS, Excel and generative AI tools efficiently, with sound judgement on accuracy, data privacy and manual review.

• Culture champion: Empathy and energy to deliver people-first experiences in a fast-moving environment.

Experience and Qualifications
• Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business, Industrial Psychology, or a related field. A Master’s degree is preferred.

• 2–3 years of experience for Associate and 3–5 years of experience for Senior Associate in HR Operations, Onboarding, or Generalist roles, preferably within a technology or SaaS environment.

231355b071496649.description: **About Zahln** Zahln, by Zysygy, is building Germany's zero-fee payment network. Merchants pay zero transaction fees. We route payments directly over SEPA Instant, bypassing Visa, Mastercard, and the entire card network chain. No hardware. No card reader. Just a phone. We are building the first company to combine a fully software-based merchant POS with a consumer super-app for everyday financial life: payments, transport, utilities, government services, all in one place. Think what UPI did for India. We are doing it for Germany, from the ground up, on banking rails. **Role Overview** You will join the core engineering team as a founding engineer. You will own the backend payment engine end to end: transaction flows, wallet management, SEPA Instant settlement, KYB/KYC integration, recurring mandates, refund logic, and the compliance export layer (DATEV, Kassenbuch, GoBD, fiskaltrust). On mobile, you will contribute to the React Native consumer and merchant apps alongside our mobile engineer. You will own what you build from development through deployment, monitoring, and production reliability. The architecture decisions you make in the first six months will run in production for years. **What you will do** * Design and build the backend payment engine: transaction flows, wallet management, SEPA Instant settlement, offline payment authorization, and recurring mandate billing. * Own KYB/KYC integration and the compliance export layer: DATEV, Kassenbuch, GoBD, and fiskaltrust for KassenSichV. * Build REST APIs for financial-grade reliability and high-throughput transaction processing, including full R-transaction handling and reconciliation pipelines. * Contribute to the React Native consumer and merchant mobile apps alongside our mobile engineer. * Own the full lifecycle of what you build, from development through deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement. **Who you are** * Meaningful hands-on experience building payment systems, fintech infrastructure, or financial APIs. * You have designed a ledger. You understand double-entry bookkeeping, immutable transaction records, and why you never update a financial row. * You have solved the partial failure. Money left one wallet and did not arrive in the other. You know how to detect it, resolve it, and make sure it does not happen again. * You understand idempotency at a design level. You have built systems that survive client retries, duplicate webhooks, and network drops without double-charging anyone. * You have built or reasoned about reconciliation: detecting discrepancies between your internal ledger and an external settlement file, and resolving them reliably at scale. * You understand KYC and KYB state machines, what happens when verification status changes mid-transaction, and what a regulator expects from your audit trail. * You are comfortable with SQL databases and own the full lifecycle of your code from development through deployment. * You can communicate technical decisions clearly to non-technical stakeholders. At this stage of the company, that matters. * You are a continuous learner. Payments infrastructure is a deep domain and you treat it that way. * You are comfortable with ambiguity and early-stage risk. There is no playbook yet. You will help write it. * Strong academic background preferred. Demonstrated engineering ability matters more than institution. **Connect with the Founder** You can also connect with me on LinkedIn at www.linkedin.com/in/shabbir-maimoon
